diagnostic_sources.voices-fused-16.onda:
const Voices = 16
const def increments() -> f32[Voices]:
  result: f32[Voices]
  for i in 0..Voices:
    result[i] = (110.0 + f32(i) * 0.37) / SR
  return result
const Increments: f32[Voices] = increments()
init:
  phases: f32[Voices]
  rendered: f32[Voices]
sample:
  mixed = 0.0
  for voice in 0..Voices:
    phase = phases[voice] + Increments[voice]
    if phase >= 1.0:
      phase -= 1.0
    phases[voice] = phase
    tone = sin(phase * TWO_PI)
    rendered[voice] = tone
    mixed += tone
  out1 = mixed / f32(Voices)

diagnostic_transformations.reverse_bounds: In the optimized MIR of bounds-reverse.onda, change the single SliceLoad in transform from clamp to unchecked. Leave SliceStore, arithmetic, control flow, and every other bound unchanged. Both variants are replayed with --trust-mir. Proof: executed body has 0 <= i < min(src.len, dst.len), hence 0 <= src.len - 1 - i < src.len; no signed arithmetic overflow for these <=512-element views.
diagnostic_transformations.equal_audio_guard: In optimized audio-map.ll replace %diff.check = icmp ult i64 %13, 128 with %diff.close = icmp ult i64 %13, 128; %diff.nonzero = icmp ne i64 %13, 0; %diff.check = and i1 %diff.close, %diff.nonzero, retaining debug locations. This admits exactly equal audio payload pointers. Verified vector loads/stores preserve per-lane order and no input/output disjointness metadata is asserted. Both baseline and variant are verified and compiled with LLVM 21.1.2 opt/llc, llc -O3 -mcpu=raptorlake -filetype=obj. Link same raw harness with gcc -O3 -ffp-contract=off -Iinclude <harness> <object> -lm. The baseline/variant processes alternate across three pairs; seven rounds per process rotate disjoint/in-place/partial-overlap layouts, one million blocks per round, sizes 1/8/32/128, FTZ/DAZ, first-block bitwise oracle and finite final output.
